lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to mark out two roads for the king of Babylon's sword: one to Rabbah, one to Jerusalem.
At the fork in the road, the king of Babylon shakes the arrows, consults the idols and examines the liver.
The omen in his right hand points to Jerusalem, where he is to direct siege towers against the gates.
The Lord GOD says to remove the robe and take off the crown, and to exalt the lowly.
God says He will judge those under the sword in their land of origin, and they will not be remembered.
